capabilities: create archive backups of the vault
exclude files and directories from backups
encrypt backups with age using a password or identity file
push and pull the backup repository to a Git remote
restore the vault from an existing backup
disambiguation: Not a vault-security tool; despite the name, its job is creating, encrypting and restoring backup archives of the vault.
extras: Requires external CLI tools (tar, age, git) installed and on PATH; backup directory must be outside the vault or excluded from the archive; excluded paths use exact matching with no wildcard support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create encrypted archive backups of a vault that can also be version-controlled and pushed to a Git remote.

relations.evidence: git for version control and remote synchronization

requires.name: tar, age and git command-line tools available on the system PATH

summary: Archive-based backup plugin that creates vault backups as tar archives, with optional age encryption and Git version control.
